projects.title: Parihar Brothers — Wholesale ERP
projects.oneLiner: Offline-first wholesale ERP replacing phone-call price checks and manual ledgers with instant lookup, cart-to-bill pipeline, and daily ledger tracking with zero internet needed.

decisions.decision: Engineered local-first mutation outbox delta-sync engine
decisions.reasoning: Employed Dexie.js/IndexedDB with client-side UUID generation so wholesale transactions operate completely offline with zero write collisions upon reconnection.

decisions.decision: Immutable price snapshot cart-to-bill pipeline
decisions.reasoning: Locks accurate wholesale prices at the instant of order creation, shielding pending drafts from subsequent master-catalog price updates.

decisions.decision: Sub-millisecond fuzzy search with Hindi phonetic aliases
decisions.reasoning: Integrated Fuse.js across ~200 inventory SKUs supporting regional aliases, letting store operators pull items instantly without phone calls.

decisions.decision: Shipped native Android APK via Capacitor with PIN-based role auth
decisions.reasoning: Enables multi-worker floor operations on handheld devices with lightning-fast PIN authentication without complex credential overhead.

decisions.decision: Built a 24-hour pass prediction engine with CSV telemetry logging

decisions.decision: Split the system into modular physics, hardware, and UI layers
decisions.reasoning: Keeps orbital math, simulated hardware state, and the interface independently testable and swappable.
